socket_path.description: Path to Unix socket used to communicate with clamd. Required when using Unix socket. Must be accessible with global executable permissions on home and ~/.claws-mail directories.

tcp_socket.description: Whether to use TCP socket instead of Unix socket. When true, tcp_host and tcp_port must be set.

tcp_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the clamd server for TCP connections.

tcp_port.description: Port number of the clamd daemon for TCP connections (standard clamd port).

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from clamd before timing out.

max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum size (in MB) of attached files to scan. 0 means no size limit.
